pitfalls_quantified.name: DecidableEq Synthesis Failure Over Higher-Order State Representations
pitfalls_quantified.symptom: `Outcome State` fails to synthesize `Decidable (Outcome.val st1 ≠ Outcome.ub)` when `State` embeds function-typed maps (`RegId → Int`, `SlotId → Int`).
pitfalls_quantified.resolution: Separate syntactic checker decidability (`Stmt`, `Expr`, `RegId`, `SlotId`, `AliasTag` all `deriving DecidableEq`) from semantic `Outcome State` discrimination (`by nofun` / constructor injection).

pitfalls_quantified.name: Implicit Frame Obligations Between Memory Slot Stores and Register Expressions
pitfalls_quantified.symptom: `promoteSlotToAssign`, `forwardStoreAcrossNoAlias`, and `elimOverwrittenStore` leave `evalExpr (st.setSlot s v) e = evalExpr st e` unreduced because `evalExpr` recurses over `Expr` while reading `st.regs`.
pitfalls_quantified.resolution: Prove a compositional `[simp]` frame lemma `evalExpr_setSlot` once by structural induction on `Expr` (10 lines), eliminating per-rule frame boilerplate.

pitfalls_quantified.name: Intermediate Statement Witness Synthesis (`inferExprRewrite` vs. Relational Checking)
pitfalls_quantified.symptom: Relational `checkExprRewrite src tgt rw : Bool` requires existential intermediate expressions in transitive chains, complicating completeness inversion.
pitfalls_quantified.resolution: Use functional endpoint synthesis `inferExprRewrite : ExprRewrite → Expr × Expr` for algebraic rewrites and explicit `mid : Stmt` witnesses on `StmtDeriv.trans`, yielding 1-line `simp` proofs per constructor in `checkStmtDeriv_complete`.

pitfalls_quantified.name: Quadratic Case-Split Expansion in Multi-Arity Inductive Congruence (`seqCong`)
pitfalls_quantified.symptom: `cases src <;> cases tgt` on a 7-constructor `Stmt` inductive produces 49 subgoals (48 impossible `false = true` goals).
pitfalls_quantified.resolution: Chain `<;> simp only [checkStmtDeriv, Bool.and_eq_true] at h <;> try contradiction` or factor a `match src, tgt` inversion lemma before scaling `Stmt` beyond 15 constructors.

full_scale_extrapolation.projected_engineer_months: 9-14 engineer-months (with 2-tier functional endpoint synthesis + shared frame lemmas)
